At a comparable point before the 2018 midterms, Civiqs recorded Trump at 43 percent approval and 53 percent disapproval, a net rating of minus 10.

Today, Trump stands at minus 26 nationally.

While approval ratings do not directly predict election outcomes, they remain one of the most closely watched indicators of the political environment facing candidates in competitive races.

## What the White House Says [...] The data comes from Civiqs' rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. A Newsweek analysis compares Trump's approval rating on September 4, 2026, with where it stood when he returned to office on January 20, 2025, using net approval calculated as approve minus disapprove.
